explanation: Mathlib has results characterizing quasi-isomorphisms by isomorphisms on homology (including `quasiIsoAt_iff_isIso_homologyMap`) and Euler-characteristic results for module categories, but I found no declaration stating invariance of the finite alternating sum of homology classes in the general abelian-category setting. The target uses the homology-map isomorphism result, together with the library-specific `of_congr`, to prove that equality.
